items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: working under Mr. Breeden in the One O’clock Lab Band

ctx.x: And I read that you switched to a different major. What was the reason for that?

Yeah I switched, became an English major in my junior year. Let me — how to put this — I knew I wanted to play music but I realized that the degrees as set up at North Texas at that time really had nothing to do with what I wanted to do musically other than getting me the great opportunity of working under Mr. Breeden in the One O’clock Lab Band, and having some wonderful classmates to work with as well. But my thinking was this is probably the only time I’m ever going to be in an institution of higher learning,…
